svg.title: Valuation engine functions
svg.desc: Execution order inside the new valuation/engine.ts module and the handler, each step linked to its acceptance criterion and the existing function it reuses.
svg.text: Detail: new src/lib/research/valuation/engine.ts, in call order

g.text: FRED macro_context doc; financial_inputs gains pretax_income + income_tax_expense — AC-1, AC-3
not ready → withheld artifacts with the missing list; skip the model call — AC-2
3 scenarios × {discount_rate, terminal, rationale}; no cash flows or prices in the schema — AC-9
4. buildScenarioStatements per scenario (base year 1 pinned to operating_model)
revenue, operating income, D&A, capex, NOPAT, ΔNWC, FCFF; a missing year throws — AC-4, AC-10
D&A always added back; cash flow equals its build by construction — AC-5
value at each year end; anchor = terminal-year price; weights only if they sum to 1 — AC-6, AC-7, AC-11
null when no value in range reaches the price — AC-8

svg.text: Handler (asset-valuation.ts) keeps persistence, valuation_signals, scenarios rows and the withheld path — AC-12.
